system.description:
Your vampiric endurance far surpasses that of any mortal or most other Cainites; blows that would stagger or kill a lesser being may not even scratch you.

When you suffer lethal or bashing damage you may make an immediate Simple Test to remove one level of that damage on a win. Before testing you may expend a stamina-related Physical Trait, which lets you succeed on a win or a tie; otherwise you must win outright. Use of Resistance is reflexive and costs no action. You may use it after reducing aggravated damage with Resilience, attempting to remove the resulting lethal level entirely. You may attempt Resistance only once against any given source of damage, so from a single attack you may negate only one level.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
